why: 'random' names no catalog entry, so a catalog-backed predicate refuses it. Without the explicit allowance every read converts the draw-for-me sentinel into a concrete board -- permanently, and silently. VersusConfig.arenaId's own doc comment is emphatic that the UNRESOLVED config is what the pane reopens with; this entry is that contract's guard at the persistence boundary.
